newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss foundation eyes revaluing gold reserves -SNB.
newsitem.headline: Swiss foundation eyes revaluing gold reserves -SNB.

text.p: A plan by the Swiss government and the Swiss National Bank to create a large humanitarian fund to aid victims of human rights abuses, catastrophes and the Holocaust focuses on revaluing official gold reserves, an SNB spokesman said.
He declined to comment on whether it might involve gold sales, adding SNB Chairman Hans Meyer and government officials would hold a news conference at 0900 GMT in Berne.
"We have gold in our books that is markedly below market value due to a legal requirement that still exists," the central bank spokesman told Reuters.

"There is a project anyway to change the constitution and the laws regulating the role of gold in monetary areas in Switzerland. This would allow the National Bank to put gold at a different price in the balance sheet. At which price is an open question."
Parliament can then decide what to do with profits from revaluing gold, he said.
